proposed_initial_profile.purpose: A single deterministic, non-network, read-only resolver profile for exact separate_store locators.

data_source.description: The first behavior implementation, if approved later, receives an immutable typed snapshot from its caller/test harness and performs exact-key lookup only.

access_model.description: Read access is limited by explicit caller hash plus profile-pinned namespace. There is no service credential, delegation, impersonation, or execution credential in this profile.

time_model.note: Determinism is defined over request + profile + immutable snapshot + injected observed_at.

proposed_failure_mapping.LOCATOR_MISSING: empty or missing locator before lookup
proposed_failure_mapping.LOCATOR_MALFORMED: unsupported scheme or noncanonical/invalid locator grammar
proposed_failure_mapping.AUTHZ_DENIED: caller hash not allowed or namespace outside pinned profile scope
proposed_failure_mapping.RESOLUTION_FAILED: canonical locator absent from the immutable snapshot
proposed_failure_mapping.SCHEMA_MISMATCH: typed store record violates the frozen minimal record shape
proposed_failure_mapping.UNKNOWN_TRANSIENT: not emitted by the initial pure snapshot profile

proposed_internal_observation.purpose: Internal immutable proof object for tests and later audit integration; not a new authority surface.

proof_obligations.what_was_observed: Exact request, locator, profile, snapshot identity and typed record/digest outcome are bound in the internal observation.
proof_obligations.when_it_was_observed: observed_at comes from an explicit injected UTC clock and is preserved exactly.
proof_obligations.under_which_bounded_read_access_authorit: caller_id_hash and profile-pinned namespace scope are preserved; there are no ambient or execution credentials.
forbidden_inferences: authenticity beyond exact typed snapshot membership

required_behavior_tests_if_implemented: valid exact locator returns RESOLVED with the exact stored sha256 digest and all semantic guarantees false
missing locator returns UNRESOLVED with LOCATOR_MISSING
unsupported scheme returns UNRESOLVED with LOCATOR_MALFORMED
percent encoding, query, fragment, dot segment, empty segment, Unicode, and overlength locator forms are rejected
caller outside the profile allowlist returns AUTHZ_DENIED before snapshot lookup
cross-namespace locator returns AUTHZ_DENIED before snapshot lookup
invalid typed store record returns SCHEMA_MISMATCH
same request/profile/snapshot/clock input produces byte-equivalent bounded result and observation
reordered snapshot construction does not change lookup outcome
snapshot mutation is impossible through the resolver interface
no network, DNS, redirect, retry, cache, filesystem, database, environment, or credential path is reachable
no result field can set Authority, digest-match, boundary-validation, execution-permission, uncertainty-erasure, or remediation guarantees true
evidence degradation or missing provenance changes success to UNRESOLVED or blocked, never to a stronger conclusion
activation_requirements: This proposal is separately reviewed and accepted before any behavior code is introduced.
Behavior implementation is a separate PR from this proposal.
The separate implementation PR preserves the exact non-network profile boundary or explicitly reopens security review.
All frozen minimal behavior tests and applicable v1.1 security-review negative/composite tests pass on the exact implementation SHA.
Any introduction of network, credentials, retries, redirects, cache, mutable shared state, persistence, or another scheme reopens security review before activation.
Behavior remains unwired from /v1/decide and execution paths until an explicit later activation decision.
